content.comment_body: Here is my first post. Is there a way to reuse flags, meaning to reference them in several places? I have five message blocks, and having this functionality would simplify my process.
Markers are designed for this purpose. In ladder logic, you can use them as contacts, and in function block diagrams, multiple blocks can be connected to the same marker.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking about reusing flags across multiple sections in their project to improve efficiency. The responses clarify that markers provide this feature, enabling repeated references in various programming blocks, which demonstrates product flexibility. There is also an indication that more accessible documentation or guidance around reusable elements would be beneficial for users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to reuse flags in different parts of their project for more efficient and streamlined configuration.
